name: hs_login
note: protocol 47, next-state LOGIN(2)

name: hs_status
note: next-state STATUS(1) -- the server-list ping path

name: hs_login_forwarded
note: proxy-forwarded NUL-delimited address: embedded U+0000 must survive as UTF-8

name: login_start
note: 16-char-max username, no UUID on the wire

name: login_encryption_response
note: fixed ciphertext -- real RSA output is randomised, so it can never be a fixture

name: keepalive_zero
note: VarInt 0 -- one byte

name: keepalive_small
note: VarInt boundary: last one-byte value

name: keepalive_two_byte
note: VarInt boundary: first two-byte value

name: keepalive_max
note: five-byte VarInt

name: keepalive_negative
note: negative VarInt: five bytes, NOT a signed short form

name: keepalive_min
note: negative VarInt at the extreme

name: chat_ascii
note: plain ASCII

name: chat_command
note: a command is sent as ordinary chat -- no client-side parsing

name: chat_unicode
note: 2-byte, 3-byte, section sign and a 4-byte astral pair: the length prefix counts BYTES, not chars

name: chat_100_chars
note: exactly vanilla's 100-character client cap

name: useentity_attack
note: the packet W-PICK makes mc-rs send at an EntityItem

name: useentity_interact_max_id
note: entity id as a five-byte VarInt

name: useentity_interact_at
note: the three trailing floats are written ONLY for INTERACT_AT, and are float, not double

name: player_onground
note: the two-byte idle packet

name: player_airborne
note: same, on-ground false

name: playerposition
note: doubles go on the wire raw -- no fixed-point truncation on 1.8 movement

name: playerposition_extreme
note: world-border-scale coordinates

name: playerposition_negzero
note: negative zero has a distinct bit pattern and must survive

name: playerlook
note: yaw/pitch are float degrees here, NOT the packed bytes the entity packets use

name: playerlook_wrapped
note: vanilla does not normalise yaw before sending

name: playerposlook
note: the packet the client actually sends most often

name: digging_start
note: ordinal 0, facing UP=1

name: digging_abort
note: ordinal 1

name: digging_stop
note: ordinal 2

name: digging_drop_item
note: Q key: position is ORIGIN and facing DOWN, both ignored by the server

name: digging_drop_all
note: ctrl-Q

name: digging_release_use
note: bow release / eating stop -- ordinal 5

name: digging_negative_pos
note: all-negative BlockPos: the 26/12/26 pack with every sign bit set

name: digging_far_pos
note: the 26-bit X/Z extremes, at the exact limit of the pack

name: place_on_block
note: ordinary placement: cursor floats are written as (int)(f * 16.0F), so 0.5 -> 8

name: place_untargeted
note: sendUseItem: position -1,-1,-1 and direction 255 -- W-RCLICK's missing fall-through

name: place_untargeted_empty_hand
note: same, with a null stack: the item slot is a bare short -1

name: place_cursor_extremes
note: cursor 1.0 truncates to 16 -- one past the 0-15 range a reader might assume

name: place_stack_with_nbt
note: damageable item: gzip-free NBT blob follows the damage short

name: place_stack_nbt_nondamageable
note: non-damageable item carrying NBT: the tag is still written -- getShareTag() is always true

name: helditem_slot0
note: hotbar slot 0

name: helditem_slot8
note: hotbar slot 8 -- the wire field is a short

name: animation
note: empty body: the whole packet is one id byte. W-SWING is about WHEN this is sent, not its bytes

name: entityaction_start_sprinting
note: ordinal 3, aux 0

name: entityaction_stop_sneaking
note: ordinal 1

name: entityaction_riding_jump
note: the only action that uses auxData -- horse jump charge

name: entityaction_open_inventory
note: ordinal 6 -- sent when mounted

name: input_forward
note: vehicle steering: 0.98 is vanilla's exact forward magnitude

name: input_all_flags
note: both flag bits set: jumping=1, sneaking=2

name: closewindow_player
note: window 0 is the always-present player inventory, and the server DOES act on it

name: closewindow_chest
note: an ordinary container id

name: clickwindow_left
note: note the field ORDER: actionNumber is written BEFORE mode, not after

name: clickwindow_shift_right
note: mode 1 shift-click, right button, empty slot

name: clickwindow_outside_drop
note: slot -999 means outside the window: a NEGATIVE short, not a VarInt

name: clickwindow_number_key
note: mode 2 hotbar swap, button = target hotbar slot

name: confirmtransaction_accept
note: W-CONFIRM: window 0 is the case vanilla answers and mc-rs does not

name: confirmtransaction_reject
note: a negative action number round-trips as a signed short

name: creative_set_slot
note: set slot 36 from the creative inventory

name: creative_clear_slot
note: a null stack clears the slot

name: creative_drop_outside
note: slot -1 drops the stack into the world

name: enchantitem
note: enchanting table, third option

name: updatesign
note: four JSON chat components, NOT four raw strings

name: abilities_creative_flying
note: all four flag bits set: 1|2|4|8 = 0x0F

name: abilities_survival
note: no flags, but the two speed floats are still sent

name: tabcomplete_plain
note: no target block: a single false byte follows the string

name: tabcomplete_with_block
note: target block present: true byte then the packed position

name: clientsettings_default
note: vanilla's own defaults, including the all-parts-on skin byte 0x7F

name: clientsettings_hidden
note: W-SETTINGS: mc-rs pins chat visibility to FULL and the skin byte to 0x7F, so this shape never leaves it

name: clientsettings_system
note: view distance 32 exceeds a signed byte and is still written as one byte

name: clientstatus_respawn
note: ordinal 0

name: clientstatus_request_stats
note: W-STATS: mc-rs constructs this nowhere

name: clientstatus_achievements
note: ordinal 2

name: pluginmessage_brand
note: the payload is the REST OF THE FRAME -- it carries no length prefix of its own

name: pluginmessage_binary
note: arbitrary bytes, including 0x00 and 0xFF

name: pluginmessage_empty
note: zero-length payload: the frame ends right after the channel name

name: spectate
note: a UUID is two big-endian longs, most significant first

name: resourcepack_loaded
note: ordinal 0

name: resourcepack_declined
note: ordinal 1

name: resourcepack_failed
note: ordinal 2

name: resourcepack_accepted
note: ordinal 3
